title: ISOGrid Nomad intent envelope, version 1 (draft)
description: Every message the ISOGrid control plane sends to an agent. The envelope is signed; the agent verifies the signature, the organization, the cluster and the freshness of the message before it looks at the payload. No intent carries a shell command or a path outside the agent's own data directory. The one exception on secret values is connection.put: when a person chooses, on ISOGrid, to keep a GitHub, GitLab or registry credential on their agent rather than on the platform, that credential travels once in this intent and goes straight into the customer's Vault.

id.description: Idempotency key. The agent records every id it has executed and answers a repeat with the stored result.

expires_at.description: Intents older than this are dropped, so a replayed message cannot execute later.

reply_to.description: Queue the agent answers on. Replies carry the intent id, a status and a payload that never includes secret values or log lines.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of every other field, made with the control plane's per-organization key.

secretReference.description: How the control plane names a secret. The agent reads the value from the customer's Vault at execution time; the value never travels.

key.description: Environment variable name or file name inside the container.

ref.description: Path below the agent's Vault prefix, for example apps/billing/DATABASE_URL.
